visual_action: A video shows a large crowd in an arena, presumably at a political rally. Animated characters Patrick Star and SpongeBob SquarePants are superimposed over the crowd. Patrick raises his finger as if having an idea, and SpongeBob looks on.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: On-screen text reads: "POV people leaving Trump's rally because he won't stop rambling about sharks & windmills"

on_screen_text.text: POV people leaving Trump's rally because he won't stop rambling about sharks & windmills

spoken_summary: The audio is a dialogue clip from the cartoon SpongeBob SquarePants. Patrick says, "I have an idea." SpongeBob asks, "Really? What is it?" Patrick replies, "Let's leave."
audio_music: The audio consists solely of a popular meme sound clip featuring dialogue from the cartoon SpongeBob SquarePants. There is no other music or background sound.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static shot of a crowd with animated characters digitally superimposed on top. There are no cuts or complex editing techniques.
manipulation_or_satire: The animated characters SpongeBob SquarePants and Patrick Star are digitally superimposed over footage of a rally crowd to create a satirical meme. Their dialogue is used to suggest that rally-goers want to leave.
central_claim: Donald Trump's rally speeches are so incoherent and absurd that even his supporters are compelled to leave.
intended_effect: To make the viewer mock Donald Trump and perceive his speeches as nonsensical, thereby diminishing his stature.
